detail.longDescription: There is something uniquely focused about drafting longform thoughts on physical paper with a fountain pen. Jeff Huleatt bridged analog writing with modern static publishing by building an Agent Skill powered by Gemini. It transcribes photos of handwritten notebook pages into formatted markdown for his Astro blog. https:// go.peterfriese.dev/tools-blogg ing-with-actual-paper?s=social&t=ext # Blogging # AI # Gemini # WebDev # Astro # DeveloperTools
